scripts.text:
[Canell]
It's well known that we must
be beautiful to captivate those
who watch us dance. But to rely
on just our outward appearance
is a ghastly waste of our full
potential as performers.
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
舞娘要吸引观众，美貌固然重要。
可若只靠外表，便白白埋没了身为表演者的潜力。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Yes, I can tell that you
don't quite understand that
the correct frame of mind is
an essential element to true
beauty. Now tell me, are you
confident in your dancing...?
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
看得出来，你还不明白，心态端正，才有真正的美。
告诉我，对自己的舞蹈有信心吗...？

scripts.text: Of course, old crone!
scripts.translation: 当然，老太婆

scripts.text: I... I'm not sure...
scripts.translation: 我...我不太确定...

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Ho-ho~ I believe you've
confused confidence with
arrogance! The naive cannot
tell there's a vitally important distinction between the two.
Now... Prepare for punishment!
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
呵呵~把自信当成傲慢了吧！
不懂事的人，才分不清两者的要紧区别。
来...受罚吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ow...!
Th-that whip!
I-i-it huuuurts!

[Canell]
Awareness of your own flaws
and faults is the first crucial
step towards improvement.
Yet your obvious neglect of
your gift of dancing is...
grounds for punishment!
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
能正视缺点，是进步最要紧的第一步。
可你这样糟蹋自己的舞蹈天分...也该受罚！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What the...? Ack!
S-stop wh-whipping
me! It... It stiiings!

[Canell]
Ho-ho~! Fortunately for
you, I will teach you what
you must learn to rise above
your current limitations. When
I'm finished with you, angels and demons won't resist your charms~
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
呵呵~！好在我会教你突破眼下的瓶颈。
等学成了，连天使恶魔都抵挡不了你的魅力~

scripts.text: No way, you're not teaching me!
scripts.translation: 不要，我才不跟你学

scripts.text: Alright, I'll see what I can learn.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我看看能学到什么

scripts.text:
[Canell]
So... You still haven't
mastered the fine art of
exuding charm and humility!
There must be consequences
for this blatant affront to our
profession! Prepare yourself!
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
看来...你还不懂得展现魅力与谦逊！
如此公然侮辱我们的行当，岂能不罚！
准备好！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Nooooo--!
Not that whip
again! Arrgh, it's--
It hurts so much!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不——！
又是那条鞭子！
啊，好——
好痛！

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Ho-ho~ It's good that you
recognize that you have much
to learn. Well, let's not waste
any time. Your first lesson will be on image training and self
visualization. Now, for that...
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
呵呵~知道自己还有得学，很好。
不耽搁了，第一课：形象训练与自我想象。
为此...

scripts.text:
[Canell]
...You must bring
me ^FF00001 Crystal Mirror^000000!
This tool is imperative
to the lesson, so fetch it
and bring it to me quickly!
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
...先给我带来^FF00001个水晶镜子^000000！
上课缺不了它，快去快回！

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Finally, you've come
with the mirror. Now,
look deeply and scrutinize
your reflection. Gaze upon
each blemish and fault, each
charming trait of your face.
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
总算把镜子带来了。
仔细端详自己的倒影，脸上每处瑕疵、每个迷人的细节，都要看清。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
No face is perfect, but
know that your face is yours
alone, and that it is what gives you a beauty that can be no
one else's. Now, repeat
these truisms after me...
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
没有完美的脸，可你的脸只属于你，这份美也是独一无二的。
来，跟着我说...

scripts.text:
[Canell]
''I am beautiful...
I am irresistable...''
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
“我很美...我让人无法抗拒...”

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am beautiful...
I am irresistable...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我很美...我让人无法抗拒...

scripts.text:
[Intoxicated Canell]
Louder!
More feeling!
''I am beautiful!
I am irresistable!
I am the most attractive
woman in the whole world!''
scripts.translation:
[陶醉的卡内尔]
大声点！
带上感情！
“我很美！
我让人无法抗拒！
我是世上最迷人的女人！”

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am beautiful!
I am irresistable!
I am the most attractive
woman in the whole world!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我很美！
我让人无法抗拒！
我是世上最迷人的女人！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYour self esteem has
sky rocketed. Fortunately,
you've managed to avoid
becoming a prima donna.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你的自信猛涨，好在还没变成个恃宠而骄的大牌。^000000

scripts.text:
[Frustrated Canell]
Did I tell you to come
back here without bringing
^FF00001 Crystal Mirror^000000!? Now go
and get it before I find
reason to punish you!
scripts.translation:
[沮丧的卡内尔]
谁让你没带^FF00001个水晶镜子^000000就回来的！？
快去找，别逼我罚你！

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Yes, the first and most
important step to becoming
beautiful is to realize and
accept your gorgeousness.
Confidence first, then beauty.
Never the other way around.
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
迈向美丽最重要的第一步，就是认识并接纳自己的美。
先有自信，才有美丽，顺序可不能颠倒。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Now that you've established
the proper attitude on beauty,
it's time for you to learn an
advanced technique of- shall
we say- enticement. I know an
expert that I highly recommend.
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
对美有了正确认识，就该学些进阶技巧了——姑且称作魅惑吧。
我认识位行家，值得向你推荐。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Go and find my sister
in Prontera Chruch. If you
mention me by name, she
should be willing to teach
you. I'd do it myself, but I need to enjoy my new Crystal Mirror~
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
去普隆德拉教堂找我姐姐，提我的名字，她应该肯教你。
本来也想亲自教，可我还得好好欣赏这面新水晶镜子~

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt figures that she'd
keep your mirror.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF果然，镜子就这样被她留下了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Ah, such a glamorous
face and figure. My
beauty is incompara--
Oh! It's you. So did my
sister in Prontera Church
teach you anything yet?
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
啊，多迷人的容貌、身段，我的美真是无可比——
哦，是你。
教堂里的姐姐，教你什么了吗？

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Ah, so were you
able to find Aelle?
Were you able to learn
anything from her?
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
找到艾勒了？
有没有学到什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, I only learned
about winks, but not so
much as how to do them.
She... She got drunk and
couldn't teach me more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实，只听懂了眨眼是怎么回事，却没学会怎么做。
她...她喝醉了，没法再教...

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Oh, I should have known
this would happen. Oh,
well, I guess there's no way
around it now. But you should
know that gettng my sister
drunk... is punishable.
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
就知道会这样，唉，也没别的办法了。
不过得让你明白，把我姐姐灌醉...可是要受罚的。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Bam!
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
啪！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
?!
What the
hell was that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
？！
刚才那是干什么？！

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Now, a true Dancer should
be able to figure out the
secret to winking on her
own. But since I'm such
a kind woman, I will deign
to explain it to you. Ho-ho~
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
真正的舞娘，本该自己悟出抛媚眼的诀窍。
不过，我这么好心，就屈尊讲给你听吧。
呵呵~

scripts.text:
^3355FFKind woman...?
But she just hit you!
Lightly, of course, but
still, a smack is a smack.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF好心...？她刚才还打了你呢！
虽说不重，可打了就是打了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Alright, the secret to
proper winking is to allow
your eyelid to seductively
move to a natural rhythm.
Close your eye for a second, then open it slowly to this count.
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
诀窍是让眼皮顺着自然的节拍，轻轻一动，流露诱惑。
先闭上一只眼，稍停一秒，再跟着节拍慢慢睁开。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Un, deux, trois~
Look at me, do it
like this. Un, deux, trois~
Now, let me see you try it.
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
Un, deux, trois~
看我，像这样，Un, deux, trois~
来，你试试。

scripts.text: Un deux trois~-
scripts.translation: Un deux trois~-

scripts.text: Un, doux trois~
scripts.translation: Un, doux trois~

scripts.text: Un, deux, trois~
scripts.translation: Un, deux, trois~

scripts.text:
[Canell]
No, no!
That's wrong,
completely wrong!
Can't you do it right?!
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
不对，不对！
全错了！
就不能做对吗？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
O-ow!
P-please...!
Not the whip again!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好...好痛！
求...求你...！
别再拿鞭子抽我了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Un, deux, trois~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
Un, deux, trois~

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Great, that's exactly
how you do it. Now,
don't forget, the elements
of rhythm and naturalness
are absolutely essential to
this technique of enticement.
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
很好，就是这样。
记住，节拍与自然的动作，是这门魅惑技巧的关键。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Now that you've mastered
the art of winking, you.
should know that you cannot
allure those who are much
stronger than you. So your
winks won't work on everyone.
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
媚眼已经学会了，不过得记住，实力远胜于你的对手，不会受你魅惑。
所以，这招并非对谁都管用。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Of course, my winks don't
have that drawback. Ho-ho~
Anyway, it's time for us to part now. I hope that you grow to
become a more glamorous and charming dancer in days to come.
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
当然，我抛的媚眼可没这毛病。
呵呵~该道别了，愿你往后成为更光彩照人、魅力四射的舞娘。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have finally learned
the Charming Wink skill.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你终于学会了眨眼之诱技能。^000000

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Hm...?
Is there anything
more you wanted to
ask me? Ah, you must
be mesmerized by my
beauty, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
嗯...？还想问什么？
啊，被我的美貌迷住了吧？

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Oh, to be so beautiful
must be a sin! I should
work in Prontera Church,
just like my sister, to
pray for forgiveness~
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
美成这样，简直是罪过！
我也该像姐姐一样，去普隆德拉教堂做事，祈求宽恕~

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Hm? Oh, I remember you!
A Gypsy now, I see~ That
look suits you. Now, I'm
sure you've forgotten a few
things since transcending,
am I right? Watch this wink...
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
嗯？哦，记得你！
已经是冷艳舞姬了，真衬你~
转生以后，忘了些本领吧？
看我这媚眼...

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Remember now? It's all
in the natural, seductive
and rhythmic movement of
the eyelid. I hope you use
your Charming Wink to let
your inner beauty shine~
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
想起来了？
全在眼皮那自然、诱人、合乎节拍的动作里。
愿你用眨眼之诱，展现内在的美~

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have learned the
Charming Wink skill.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你学会了眨眼之诱技能。^000000

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Oh, you're such an
adorable little girl! Ah,
I'm sorry, but when you
become a lady at, oh, I don't
know, Job Level 40, then I'll
be able to teach you something~
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
哦，多可爱的小姑娘！
不过，得等你长成淑女，嗯，比如职业等级到40级吧，才能教你点本领~

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Oh, what a cute
little girl~! Such
a chubby lil' belly,
so cuuuuuuuuuuute~
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
哦，好可爱的小姑娘~！
圆滚滚的小肚子，太~可爱了~

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Hey there,
handsome~
^333333*Wink~*^000000

^3355FFStrangely enough,
her wink has made
your heart throb.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF奇怪的是，她的眨眼让你的心怦怦直跳。^000000

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Pssst, hey! I got
some cheap, but slightly
illegal, warps to the Orc
Dungeon, Glast Heim
and the Dead Pit. So
you want in on this?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
嘘，嘿！
我这儿有便宜的传送服务，能去兽人地下城、格拉斯特海姆，还有死亡矿坑，不过稍微有点不合法。
要不要来一次？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, um, I'm here
to look for somebody.
You wouldn't happen
to know Canelle's
sister, would you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实，嗯，我是来找人的。
你碰巧认识卡内尔的姐姐吗？

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Ah, so my stuck up
sister sent you, huh?
I should have known,
judging from your clothes.
So you want to become a
more alluring performer, eh?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
啊，我那自命不凡的妹妹让你来的？
看这身衣服，早该想到。
想做个更迷人的表演者，是吧？

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Awww...
That's disappointing.
So... You didn't come
here to buy these warps?
You sure you don't want any?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
哎呀...真扫兴，不是来买传送的啊？
真不考虑一下？

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Okay, okay...
So you came for me to
teach you some enticement
technique or something, right?
Huh. Well, this lecture I give?
It's long and complicated.
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
好好好，是来学魅惑技巧的吧？
不过，我这堂课可长，讲起来也复杂。

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Talking and explaining
all of the intricate details
for so long will definitely
parch my throat. So first, you
gotta bring me a refreshing
drink before we can begin...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
细节那么多，要讲这么久，肯定口干舌燥。
先弄点清爽的饮料来，再开课...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh... Okay.
Alright, I guess
I can spare a potion
or two, or maybe bring
back a bottle of juic--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦...好吧，拿一两瓶药水，或者带瓶果汁——

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Whoa, whoa, none of
that junk! I want to
have a real drink.
You know, something
more... ^FF0000Alcohol^000000ic.
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
停停停，那些玩意儿不要！
来点真正的饮料，你懂的，带点...^FF0000酒精^000000的。

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Oh, and I need some
snacks to sustain all of
my teaching energy! Yeah,
some yummy fruit on a plate
and some cookies too!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
哦，还得有零嘴，不然哪有力气讲课！
来盘好吃的水果，再配些饼干！

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Soooo, I wanna eat
^FF00001 Apple^000000, ^FF00003 Bananas^000000 and
^FF00005 Well-Baked Cookies^000000. Ah,
make sure you bring ^FF0000China^000000
to serve them on, and don't
forget the ^FF0000Alcohol^000000, okay?

[Aelle]
One last thing...!
Don't let anyone here
in the church know what
we're doing. I don't wanna
get in too much trouble!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
最后一件事...别让教堂里的人知道！
我可不想惹麻烦！

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Great, you've brought
the food! It's a good thing
I'm famished because
I'm going to finish it all!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
太好了，吃的来了！
正饿得不行，这些我可全包了！

scripts.text:
^3355FFAelle devoured the
food like a ravenous,
hungry beast that had
been deprived for too long.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF艾勒像一只饥饿已久的野兽，狼吞虎咽地吃光了食物。^000000

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
That was sooo good!
I haven't eaten so much
in such a long time! Then
again, you don't get many
chances to pig out in church.
Ah, that's right, the lesson!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
好吃极了！
好久没吃这么饱！
教堂里哪有这么多机会敞开肚皮吃。
啊，对，还得上课！

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Now, the easiest, most
subtle and most appealing
gesture of all time is the
^FF0000wink^000000. It's saved me in times
of crisis, and mastering it
will enhance your charms.
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
最简单、最含蓄、又最迷人的动作，莫过于^FF0000眨眼^000000。
它救过我的急，学好了，你也会更有魅力。

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
To the untrained eye,
the wink only looks like
a simple movement, right?
You close one eye, and then
you reopen that eye. But if
you do it right... If you...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
外行看着，不就是闭上一只眼，再睁开吗？
可若用对了...若是...

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Oh, it's been so long
since I've had so much
to drink! Ugh, f-feeling
kinda--anyway, j-just close
and yer-- ^333333*burp*^000000 winking
is so so so so eeeeeasy~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
好久...没喝这么多了！
呃，有、有点——算了，闭、闭上，再——^333333*嗝*^000000眨眼可太太太太简单啦~

scripts.text:
[Drunken Aelle]
Do it! Copy me as
I do it! Wink, j-just
like this, okay? Y' see?
^333333*Wiiiiiiiiiiiiiink*^000000
scripts.translation:
[喝醉的艾勒]
来！跟、跟着我做！
像这样抛个媚眼，看懂没？
^333333*眨~眼*^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wh-whoa...
That was...
It's so beautiful!
And all with just
a simple wink!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇...刚才那下...好美！
只不过眨了一下眼，竟然就...

scripts.text:
[Totally Drunk Aelle]
Y-yea... The...
The secret ish...
*Urp* It'sh in the--
Bwahahahaahah!
It's all spinning!
scripts.translation:
[烂醉的艾勒]
对、对...窍门就、就在——
*Urp*
Bwahahahaahah!
天旋地转啦！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIn her drunken stupor,
Aelle pummels you with
her fists and laughs
maniacally to herself.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF艾勒醉得迷迷糊糊，一面拿拳头捶你，一面自顾自地狂笑。^000000

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
How can you expect
me to teach you anything
if I faint in the middle of
the lesson? That's right,
I'll need some nourishing,
yet delicious, snacks to eat~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
课上到一半，我要饿晕了，怎么教你？
对，得来些又营养又好吃的零嘴~

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Soooo, I wanna eat
^FF00001 Apple^000000, ^FF00003 Bananas^000000 and
^FF00005 Well-Baked Cookies^000000. Ah,
make sure you bring ^FF0000China^000000
to serve them on, and don't
forget the ^FF0000Alcohol^000000, okay?

[{0}]
You still haven't told
me the secret to making
a simple wink have so
much provocative charm.
I really need to--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你还没讲，怎么才能让眨眼这么简单的动作，变得那么撩人。
我还得——

scripts.text:
[Totally Hammered Aelle]
ZzzZzz... Huh?
Yesh, I know, I'm...
I'm a geeenius, yeah...
...ZzzzZzzzZzZzzzZZZzz...
scripts.translation:
[不省人事的艾勒]
ZzzZzz...嗯？
对，我知道，我是...天才嘛...
...ZzzzZzzzZzZzzzZZZzz...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
W-wake up!
I went through
all this trouble to
learn this technique!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
醒、醒醒！
我费这么大劲，就是想学这招啊！

scripts.text:
[Annoyed Aelle]
SHADDUP!
I'M SHLEEEEEPY!
G-go away. Talk to
Canell, my sister...
...ZzzzzZzZZZzzzZZ....
scripts.translation:
[恼火的艾勒]
闭嘴！
困~死了！
走、走开，找我妹妹卡内尔去...
...ZzzzzZzZZZzzzZZ....

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Aelle, I really
need you to teach
me everything else
I need to know about
winking and--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
艾勒，眨眼还有好多诀窍，你还没教我，还有——

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
^333333*Hiccup*^000000 Zzz--wha?
I need ta teach you
to go'way. Talk to my
sister, too tired now.
Go lemme alone girl!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
^333333*嗝*^000000Zzz——干嘛？
我得教你...走开。
去找我妹妹，我累了。
丫头，别烦我！

scripts.text:
[Sober Aelle]
Ohhh...
H-headache...
scripts.translation:
[清醒的艾勒]
噢...
头好痛...

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Oh, wow, look at you!
I can tell that you've
become much more
beautiful. Yes, you're
more elegant and refined
than I can remember.
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
哇，看看你，漂亮多了！
比印象里更优雅、更有气质了。

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Always believe in your
beauty, wield your charm
like a weapon... And anything
you desire in this world can
be yours! Bwahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
永远相信自己的美，把魅力当成武器...世上想要什么，就能得到什么！
Bwahahahahaha!

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Pssst, hey! I got
some cheap, but slightly
illegal, warps to the Orc
Dungeon, Glast Heim
and the Dead Pit. So
you want in on this?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
嘘，嘿！
我这儿有便宜的传送服务，能去兽人地下城、格拉斯特海姆，还有死亡矿坑，不过稍微有点不合法。
要不要来一次？

scripts.text:
[??????]
Sister Aelle...
Are you still trying
to sell illegal warps
again? Sister Aelle?
scripts.translation:
[??????]
艾勒修女...还在兜售非法传送服务吗？
艾勒修女？

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Oh crap, it's the pastor!
Shhh, if anybody asks you,
I wasn't doing anything!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
糟糕，是牧师来了！
嘘，如果有人问起，就说我什么都没做！

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Thanks, hon...
I know you can
keep my contraband
our little secret. ^333333*Wink*^000000
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
谢啦，亲爱的...知道你会替我保守这点违禁生意的小秘密。
^333333*眨眼*^000000
